description: This file defines types, constants, and function prototypes for the LVPSA (Level and Spectrum Analyzer) module, including memory management, initialization, control, processing, and spectrum retrieval functions. It is part of a media effects library related to spectrum analysis in audio processing.

methods.name: LVPSA_Memory
methods.description: Handles memory allocation and freeing for the LVPSA module, either returning requirements or allocated addresses.

methods.name: LVPSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the LVPSA module with given parameters and memory table.

methods.name: LVPSA_Control
methods.description: Updates control parameters of the LVPSA module.

methods.name: LVPSA_Process
methods.description: Calculates frequency band levels from input samples.

methods.name: LVPSA_GetSpectrum
methods.description: Retrieves current spectrum level values and peaks.
